requirements.description: The architecture provides diagnostic and display endpoints for the showcase.
requirements.title: Provide diagnostic and display endpoints

requirements.description: The architecture provides typed context signals for the showcase.
requirements.title: Provide typed context signals

requirements.description: The brake controller shall process every brake request within one control cycle.
requirements.title: Brake request processing

requirements.description: The brake controller shall receive the brake request from the pedal interface.
requirements.title: Brake request input

requirements.description: The brake controller shall apply only the permitted brake action.
requirements.title: Permitted brake action applied

requirements.description: The brake controller shall read the rear brake temperature before each brake request is processed.
requirements.title: Rear brake temperature use

requirements.description: A brake request that exceeds the permitted brake action shall be limited, not rejected.
requirements.title: Brake request rejection

requirements.description: Processing of a brake request shall complete within 10 ms.
requirements.title: Brake request timing

requirements.description: The brake request shall be checked for plausibility against the operating state.
requirements.title: Brake request plausibility

requirements.description: The brake pressure shall ramp up at no more than 200 bar/s.
requirements.title: Brake pressure ramp

requirements.description: The brake controller shall be ready to process a brake request 50 ms after start.
requirements.title: Brake controller start

requirements.description: In degraded mode the brake controller shall keep the last permitted brake action.
requirements.title: Brake controller degraded mode

requirements.description: The pedal feel shall remain constant over the full temperature range.
requirements.title: Pedal feel

requirements.description: Each rejected brake request shall be reported to diagnostics.
requirements.title: Brake request logging

requirements.description: The diagnostic manager shall process every thermal protection event.
requirements.title: Diagnostic event processing

requirements.description: On a thermal protection event the diagnostic manager shall store a snapshot in non-volatile storage.
requirements.title: Snapshot storage

requirements.description: The diagnostic manager shall serve a read snapshot request from the tester.
requirements.title: Snapshot read service

requirements.description: Brake diagnostics shall be published to the instrument cluster.
requirements.title: Brake diagnostics publication

requirements.description: Diagnostic events shall not be stored while the ECU mode is shutdown.
requirements.title: ECU mode dependency

requirements.description: A failed non-volatile storage write shall be retried once.
requirements.title: NvM write retry

requirements.description: A snapshot shall hold the brake temperature and the permitted brake action.
requirements.title: Snapshot content

requirements.description: A diagnostic event shall be debounced over three evaluation cycles.
requirements.title: Event debouncing

requirements.description: Stored trouble codes shall be cleared only by a tester request.
requirements.title: DTC clearing

requirements.description: The extended diagnostic session shall time out after 5 s without a request.
requirements.title: Diagnostic session

requirements.description: The instrument cluster shall display the thermal protection status.
requirements.title: Thermal status display

requirements.description: The instrument cluster shall update the thermal status within 100 ms.
requirements.title: Thermal status update

requirements.description: The instrument cluster shall show brake diagnostics to the driver.
requirements.title: Brake diagnostics display

requirements.description: The instrument cluster shall display the odometer.
requirements.title: Odometer display

requirements.description: A brake fade warning lamp shall be lit while thermal protection is active.
requirements.title: Warning lamp

requirements.description: Display brightness shall follow the ambient light sensor.
requirements.title: Display brightness

requirements.description: The vehicle state manager shall publish the operating state every 100 ms.
requirements.title: Operating state publication

requirements.description: The operating state shall be valid 100 ms after ignition on.
requirements.title: Operating state start

requirements.description: Thermal protection shall be evaluated every 50 ms from the brake temperature.
requirements.title: Thermal protection evaluation

requirements.description: Thermal protection shall be initialised at start with a cold brake assumption.
requirements.title: Thermal protection initialisation

requirements.description: When the brake temperature exceeds 600 degC the permitted brake action shall be reduced.
requirements.title: Permitted action under fade

requirements.description: The thermal protection status shall be published to the instrument cluster.
requirements.title: Thermal protection status

requirements.description: A thermal protection event shall be raised when the permitted brake action is reduced.
requirements.title: Thermal protection event

requirements.description: The brake temperature sensor shall publish the brake temperature every 50 ms.
requirements.title: Brake temperature publication

requirements.description: The brake temperature shall be carried from -40 degC to 1000 degC.
requirements.title: Brake temperature range

requirements.description: Thermal protection shall take the vehicle operating state into account.
requirements.title: Operating state use

requirements.description: A brake temperature sensor fault shall set the thermal protection status to unknown.
requirements.title: Temperature sensor fault

requirements.description: The cooling of the brake disc shall be estimated from vehicle speed.
requirements.title: Cooling estimate

requirements.description: Thermal protection shall restore the full permitted brake action below 400 degC.
requirements.title: Thermal protection recovery

requirements.description: The fade warning threshold shall be calibratable.
requirements.title: Fade warning threshold

requirements.description: B(D) decomposition of REQ_BTP_SAFETY_GOAL, monitor channel: the thermal protection derates the permitted brake action when the brake temperature rises. The independence a decomposition assumes is not modelled: both channels run in Task_50ms on Core1, and the monitor reads the main channel's brake temperature.
requirements.title: Monitor channel limits the permitted brake action

requirements.description: Design constraint: the worst-case load of each core of the processor, the sum over the tasks that run on it of wcet divided by period, shall stay at or below the core's budget, 70 % on Core0 and 60 % on Core1, enforced strictly.
requirements.title: Each core stays within its load budget

requirements.description: B(D) decomposition of REQ_BTP_SAFETY_GOAL, main channel: the sensor measures the brake temperature and the controller applies only the permitted brake action.
requirements.title: Main channel measures the temperature and applies the brake request

requirements.description: The diagnostics record every thermal protection event and store a snapshot in non-volatile memory.
requirements.title: Record thermal protection events

requirements.description: Design constraint: the runnables of both decomposed channels shall run in a partition rated at least ASIL B, on a core whose ASIL capability is at least the partition's level, and the memory they use shall be capable of at least ASIL B.
requirements.title: Both channels run in an ASIL B context

requirements.description: Safety goal: the brake system shall not lose braking capability because the brakes overheat. Decomposed into REQ_BTP_DECOMP_MAIN and REQ_BTP_DECOMP_MONITOR, each ASIL B(D). Illustrative.
requirements.title: Prevent brake fade from thermal overload

requirements.description: Design constraint: every interface that carries the brake temperature shall carry it in degrees Celsius over the physical range -40 degC to 1000 degC at a resolution of 0.1 degC, both ends of the range included.
requirements.title: The brake temperature is carried from -40 to 1000 degC at 0.1 degC

requirements.description: The brake thermal protection evaluates the brake temperature and publishes the permitted brake action, its status and its events.
requirements.title: Brake thermal protection evaluates and publishes

requirements.description: The brake temperature shall have a resolution of 0.1 degC.
requirements.title: Brake temperature resolution

requirements.description: The core load shall stay below 70 percent.
requirements.title: Core load limit

requirements.description: The service brake shall remain available after a single fault.
requirements.title: Service brake availability

requirements.description: The software shall be updatable over the diagnostic interface.
requirements.title: Software update
